rows.en: <operator(19020,2)><speed(2)>Hey, hey, are you the people who supposedly came from a faraway world?
<operator(19020,2)><speed(2)>I pilot <color(4)>Shin Getter-2<ce()>. I'm <color(4)>Kei<ce()>. Let's beat <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> with our own hands and bring peace back fast.
rows.notes: Unit name placed before the personal name so the colored spans stay in source order.

rows.en: <operator(19020,2)><speed(2)>Let me introduce the other two. The pilot of <color(4)>Shin Getter-1<ce()> is <color(4)>Go<ce()>.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>...
<operator(19030,2)><speed(2)>I'm <color(4)>Gai<ce()>. I pilot <color(4)>Shin Getter-3<ce()>.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>I'm <color(4)>Benkei<ce()>. I used to be a Getter pilot, but these days I back these three up.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>They haven't been piloting long, but I'm counting on you. Look after my daughter <color(4)>Kei<ce()> too.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Sure. Glad to have you with us.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Still, this <color(4)>Shin Getter<ce()> is one heck of a machine... man.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Hey, <color(4)>Faye<ce()>. When are we going to be able to catch this <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> guy?
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, right now you need to focus on the operation.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>But if we keep doing things like this, we'll never get to go home.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Ensign <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>. I have already explained why our cooperation matters, have I not?
rows.notes: shoui = Ensign per the project's rank notes (Ensign/Lieutenant convention); no reviewed row with Barrel's rank found to confirm.

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...I know that.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>You should be that agreeable from the start.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, was it? So you ended up dragged into this too.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I don't intend to stay in a place like this for long.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah, of course not...
rows.notes: Barrel sympathizing with Gainer's wish to leave.

rows.en: <operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Feel like you're looking at yourself from a little while ago?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I'm getting off this ship too once we get back!
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>The <color(5)>Invaders<ce()> gather at <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> in search of Getter Rays... huh.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>In other words, it's also a chance to wipe out both at once.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>I'm getting tired of fighting those monsters anyway. I'd like to finish them off right about now.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>Don't... underestimate them.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Hayato<ce()> and I once rode Getter and fought them to the death on the lunar surface.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)>But when we thought we had destroyed them, they revived and showed themselves before us again...
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>And even now they fly around as if they own the place, wreaking all the destruction they can.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Being scared won't get us anywhere. We only have to smash 'em, right?!
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>Heh... exactly. It's reassuring to have a man like you around.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()> and the <color(5)>Invaders<ce()>... I will never forgive them.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>That's some heavy talk. What happened?
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Thanks to <color(5)>Shin Dragon<ce()>, we were forced to live a dark, harsh life in an underground shelter.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>That's not all. We lived in constant terror, always cowering at their shadow.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Man, you've been through something awful...
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>We're gonna lend you a hand too!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>...I wonder if <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> is okay.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>What's up, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>She's anxious - says she had a bad dream.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>True... I have something like a bad feeling myself.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>You're a Newtype too, right?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I can't see the future or anything like that.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>So even among Newtypes, there are all kinds.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>...Take good care of <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>...<color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, is something wrong?
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>This child... the <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> is angry. A silent, yet very strong anger...
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>The <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()>? You mean it's sensing something?
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, are you still grumbling? You're a boy, aren't you?!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>My parents had nothing to do with Exodus... and the pro-Exodus crowd killed them!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>You have my sympathy, kid... But if you don't fight, everyone dies. <color(4)>Sara<ce()> there is no exception.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I... hate Exodus, but I hate seeing the people around me get hurt even more.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I've got no choice, so I'll fight... but <color(4)>Gain<ce()>! It's not for your sake, got it?!
rows.notes: Source uses a polite -san on Gain; dropped, as no honorific convention for Gain was found in reviewed rows.

checked_decisions: 0/31 (text id 32) 'Ensign Barrel': source rank word is 'shoui' (Barrel + shoui). Glossary files (glossary.json char.barrel_orland, character_names_021.json) record NO rank for Barrel - role is 'civilian student who becomes an Ixbrau pilot'. The rank is nevertheless real in the game: a disc scan finds the same 'Barrel shoui' in mission dialogue resources 6280 and 6450 (and their copies 2002280/2002450/3200280/3200450/3201280/3201450), spoken when he is asked to shut down the Baldora Drive. The project's reviewed convention renders shoui as 'Ensign' (dialogue_00608, 'Ensign Uraki' in dialogue_00623/00625/01542) and chuui as 'Lieutenant', and Ruri's own rank uses the naval mapping (Lt. Cmdr.). 'Ensign' kept.
0/20 unit name before personal name so the two color spans stay in source order (Shin Getter-2, then Kei): command order verified identical. Accepted.
0/24 'these three' for 'koitsura': the number is not in the source but is fixed by the scene (Go, Kei, Gai just introduced). Left; merely different.
0/25 'Look after my daughter Kei too': source 'musume no Kei mo yoroshiku na'. Accepted.

1/21 (text id 22) Barrel 'yappari sou da yo na' rendered 'Yeah, of course not...': agrees with Gainer's 'I do not intend to stay long'; Faye's next line ('like looking at yourself a while ago?') confirms sympathy reading. Accepted.
1/141 (text id 142) 'She's anxious': referent is Tiffa (named one row earlier), female in the glossary. Accepted.
1/223 (text id 224) '-san' on Gain dropped: no honorific convention in reviewed scenes; tone (grudging, polite 'arimasen kara ne') still readable. Accepted.
Names checked against glossary/unit files: Shin Getter-1/-2/-3, Shin Dragon, Invaders, Getter Rays, Berkt, Tiffa, Garrod, Nirvash, Gainer, Gain, Sara, Exodus, Hayato, Benkei, Go, Kei, Gai.
remaining_uncertainties: 0/31: Barrel's rank is absent from every glossary file; suggest the orchestrator add 'Ensign (shoui), field rank used by Ruri and mission dialogue' to char.barrel_orland so later slices (resources 6280/6450) render it the same way.
1/63 (text id 64) 'fought them to the death': source 'shitou wo kurihirogeta' = waged a desperate/deadly battle; nobody died to the end. Close enough idiomatically, left.
